query: What is the exact salary range for a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Google in London?
ground_truth: The salary range for a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Google in London is approximately **£100,000 to £142,500**, with an average of **£121,200**. To negotiate effectively, focus on highlighting your specialized skills, certifications, and any experience with cutting-edge technologies.
